# ab_test.csv
Schema: user_id, date (Oct 2026, 28 days), variant (control/treatment), platform (ios/android/web), country (BR,DE,IN,UK,US), sessions, saves, converted. 6000 rows, no nulls/dups.
Quirks: 630 rows have saves > sessions, so "save rate" = saves per session (not a strict proportion). Variant split ~50/50 in each platform.
## Findings
- 2026 (session date): Save rate = sum(saves)/sum(sessions). iOS 56.8% [55.4,58.3], Android 46.7% [45.3,48.1], Web 45.2% [43.5,47.0]. iOS-Android diff +10.1pt [8.1,12.1]. iOS leads in all 5 countries. Per-user mean ratio gives same ranking.
- iOS lead is driven by treatment: iOS treatment 67.5% vs control 46.1%; android/web show no variant effect. Without treatment, iOS is about equal to others.
- Chart: save_rate_by_platform.png (bars + CI).

events.text:
**iOS has the highest save rate, at 56.8% saves per session.** That is about 10 points above Android, and the gap is not close.

| Platform | Users | Save rate (saves/sessions) | 95% CI |
|---|---|---|---|
| iOS | 2,662 | 56.8% | 55.4–58.3% |
| Android | 2,142 | 46.7% | 45.3–48.1% |
| Web | 1,196 | 45.2% | 43.5–47.0% |

iOS minus Android is +10.1 points (95% CI 8.1 to 12.1). iOS also ranks first in all 5 countries.

Sample rows:

| user_id | date | variant | platform | country | sessions | saves | converted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 2026-10-21 | treatment | web | BR | 9 | 3 | 0 |
| 1 | 2026-10-02 | control | web | UK | 7 | 3 | 0 |
| 2 | 2026-10-04 | treatment | ios | DE | 8 | 3 | 0 |
| 3 | 2026-10-02 | control | android | BR | 6 | 2 | 0 |
| 4 | 2026-10-04 | treatment | ios | DE | 3 | 3 | 0 |

Caveats:
- **The iOS lead comes from the treatment arm.**
  - iOS treatment users save at 67.5% and iOS control users at 46.1%.
  - Android and web show no difference between arms.
  - In the control arm, iOS is level with the other platforms, so iOS isn't naturally better.
- **Save rate is saves per session, not a true percentage.** 630 rows have more saves than sessions. I defined it as total saves divided by total sessions.
- **Same ranking with another definition.** Averaging each user's own saves-to-sessions ratio gives the same order, with iOS first.
- **Confidence intervals** come from resampling users 2,000 times.

The chart is saved at `$OUTPUT_DIR/save_rate_by_platform.png`.
